name: Macau
officialName: Macao Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China

flag.description: A green field with a white lotus flower above a stylised bridge and white waves, beneath an arc of five yellow five-pointed stars.
flag.symbolism: The lotus is Macau's emblem, its three petals for the peninsula and the islands of Taipa and Coloane; the bridge and water show its setting, and the five stars echo China's flag.

hook: Macau is a white lotus floating on a green field under five gold stars; Hong Kong's flower is a bauhinia on red.
trivia: The flag was first raised officially on 20 December 1999, when Portugal handed Macau to China after more than four centuries.
Macau is among the most densely populated places in the world.
